data.description: An ancient or older brass dragon can create a powerful sandstorm once per day as a full-round action. This storm has a radius of 1 mile and lasts for 1 minute per age category of the dragon. This functions as a sandstorm, except that it is also accompanied by windstorm-level winds.
data.name: Sandstorm
